comment: One row covers a borrowed result that designates storage with owning leaves.
The body-summary module is outside the compiler binary. The build compiles the focused test.
Run this table in the Linux VM after you build the debug preset.
build: mkdir -p build/Linux/debug/summary-result-mutate && cd test/fort && ../../build/Linux/debug/fort -I ../../src/fort -I support ownership_summary_result_test.ft -o ../../build/Linux/debug/summary-result-mutate/ownership_summary_result_test

stages.name: the summary suites
stages.command: python3 test/lang/run_tests.py --root test/fort --fort build/Linux/debug/fort --std-dir build/Linux/debug/std --cc /usr/bin/clang --target x86_64-linux-gnu -j 6 ownership_calls_ ownership_recursive ownership_indirect ownership_summary_

mutations.what: a borrowed result whose element owns storage stays unsupported
